asked: # Build: smart-menus (Urgent profile) Brett, Nov 3 2026 (voice): "I need a dynamic context menu that draws itself depending on where it is and what it's doing. Most common / most likely things at the top. It learns and remembers, predicts what I'm most likely gonna want, keeps that at the top." Assigned agent: **Earl the Ear** (book on his card; if busy and the all-rounder router is on main, whoever is free - record who). Register in Urgent (id `smart-menus`) + banner entry. ## Build (framework level: every context menu in every app, existing and future) - s1 **Context-aware drawing:** the context menu engine builds the menu at open time from: the target under the pointer (element kind, hook@1 / control@1 target, plugin, screen), its state (selected, running, failed, waiting on approval, has PR, etc.), the current screen, device (phone/desktop). Plugins contribute items with `when` conditions (state predicates) so irrelevant items never show; runtime context items stay the contribution path. - s2 **Learning ranking, zero tokens:** record every pick locally + synced to axHub per user: (context [hidden] kind + state + screen, item id, time). Rank with frecency (frequency x recency decay) per context, plus time-of-day and 'what I just did' sequence boosts (simple Markov next-action counts). Top section 'Suggested' = top 3-5 predicted items; the rest grouped below in stable order so muscle memory still works. Plain code, NO LLM calls (test fails if the engine imports an LLM client). - s3 Pinned items always first (from the pending `context-menu-editor` idea: user pins), then Suggested, then the rest; destructive items never auto-promoted to the top. - s4 Settings (Settings > Menus, and a 'Menu settings' hook in every context menu): learning on/off, number of suggestions, reset learning (per menu / all), show why it's suggested (tiny hint), privacy: data stays on his axHub. - s5 Works with menu-scroll (#268) placement and the toolbar build's hook@1/drop-target@1 if on main (don't edit their files). Commands declared once -> REST + MCP + CLI (get suggestions, reset, pin). - s6 Tests (ranking math, context keys, when-conditions, reset, destructive never top), phone + desktop screenshots, UI Review item, report `_claude/builds/reports/smart-menus.md`, THREADS, PR, steps through the store. Commits clean and professional. ## Addendum 1 (Brett, Nov 3 2026, voice, before start): dynamic SECTIONS, not the whole menu Don't make the whole menu dynamic. Each context menu keeps its normal fixed items in their fixed order (muscle memory). Add dynamic SECTIONS on top of that: - A 'Suggested' section at the top (learned/predicted items, 3-5, per s2) - can be turned off. - A context section (items that only apply to this target/state, per s1 'when' conditions), clearly grouped. - Pinned items (user pins). The rest of the menu is static and never reorders. A menu asset declares which dynamic sections it shows and where; the default is Suggested at top + context section, static items below. ## Addendum 2 (Brett, Nov 3 2026, voice): application menus too + 'what we're talking about' goes to the top - The dynamic sections apply to the **application menu bar** too (every top-level menu: Builds, View, Tools, etc.), not just context menus. Permanent items stay fixed; each menu can declare dynamic sections. - New dynamic section **'Talking about'** at the top of every menu (app menus + context menus): items relevant to what Brett and Amber (Claude) are currently talking about. Example: open Builds in the app menu while we're discussing the toolbar build -> that build (open it, its PR, its UI Review, its agent, stop it) is at the top. - How it knows: add MCP tool `console_context` (policy ALLOW, navigation-only, no data change) on axf-console: {topics: [{kind: build|plugin|screen|pr|agent|setting|profile|note, id, label}], ttl_min?}. Amber calls it whenever the conversation moves to something (and console_show / follow-amber can feed it too). The console …
